gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying the construction type of a load transfer platform (LTP), planned or as-built - unreinforced granular fill, geogrid-reinforced fill, soil-mixed/cemented raft, or a structural concrete slab. Used for the value of diggs:RILTPSpecificationType/platformType (planned) and diggs:LoadTransferPlatformType/platformType (as-built) so design and as-built share one vocabulary. Distinct from materialType (diggs:LithologyPropertyType), which classifies what the fill is made of geologically and cannot express a structural concrete slab or a soil-mixed raft, neither of which is a lithology (V2 Design row 50).
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Load Transfer Platform Type Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A compacted granular fill platform with no geosynthetic reinforcement or cementitious binder.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Unreinforced Granular Fill

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A granular fill platform reinforced with one or more geogrid or geotextile layers. Recorded here as an explicit classification even though it is also derivable from whether diggs:LoadTransferPlatformType/geosynthetics (as-built) or diggs:GeosyntheticLayerDesign (design) is populated - stating it directly lets a reviewer read the platform's construction type from one field rather than checking for the presence of a child array.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Geogrid-Reinforced Fill

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ soil mixed with a cementitious binder to form a stiffened raft, rather than a granular fill placed above grade.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Soil-Mixed / Cemented Raft

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A reinforced or unreinforced structural concrete slab used as the load transfer platform, the extreme case among the platform types this list covers.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Structural Concrete Slab
